review_context.reviewer: Coordinator, distinct from both draft authors.
review_context.method: The delegated fresh-context reviewer returned only an acknowledgement and no review artifact. The coordinator completed the review directly: handoff metadata was already visible, then the original scoped PDF text was read before the six catalogues and all 27 programs. PDF visuals and necessary canonical passages were inspected during that review, followed by the current fingerprinted compiler observations.
review_context.limitation: This is independent of the fixture authors, not a claim of a completed fresh-context or different-model review.

6.1.1.rationale: The processor-dependent repertoire and graphic/control partition are definitions. All five graphic classes, both character-set definitions, three R601 alternatives, prescribed graphics, currency exception, and unspecified style are accounted for. Name-suffix admission controls do not claim glyph rendering or arbitrary-character rejection.

6.1.2.rationale: All 26 alphabet members, both required cases, equivalence outside the two exact character contexts, and the informative CALL example are accounted for. Direct character equality avoids an unnecessary integer-kind premise while preserving the finite repertoire oracle.

6.1.3.rationale: The introduction, all ten digit members, and the syntax-class definition are classified without a fabricated semantic S requirement. R601's digit admission controls do not become full local effect coverage or a claim of contiguous codes.

6.1.4.rationale: The terminal is admitted in a legal short name and is distinguished from omission of that terminal. R603 keeps ownership of initial-position and name-grammar restrictions.

6.2.1.rationale: All sixteen listed token alternatives, introductory scope, and the complex-literal exception are accounted for. The five noncomplex-literal facets refine one union member. Complex literals are not prohibited, punctuation inside literals is not separately credited, and canonical lexical/construct ownership is unchanged.

6.2.6.rationale: The delimiter-token premise and all seven spellings, including the two-character constructor delimiters, are accounted for. Matched pairs are positive controls in legal expression, DATA, and array-constructor contexts, not scanner-token-count or arbitrary-character rejection evidence.

premises_and_oracles: R601/R602 controls use short legal names, define every scalar, and distinguish digit/underscore spellings with independent values.
The 52-character repertoire comparison has 1326 distinct-position pairs; the inner loop has zero iterations at the final outer position and never forms an out-of-range substring.
All 26 one-letter name pairs are assigned and checked. Mixed-case program/procedure names and keywords have matching interfaces and a defined scalar result.
Both literal delimiter forms preserve the sampled case pairs. Explicit unequal-case checks prevent folding both source and expected literals from producing a false pass.
Both FORMAT edit-string forms write four characters into initialized four-character internal records; IOSTAT is checked before the records are inspected, including unequal-case checks.

Token controls use legal initialized scalar arithmetic, BOZ integer DATA, a forward branch, an in-bounds fixed-shape section, same-type scalar pointer association, an allowed assumed-rank inquiry, and an initialized scalar component.
The question-mark control has matching scalar integer alternatives and separately checks true/false selections.

The .NIL. control has a scalar logical condition, one integer consequent argument, and an explicit internal interface with an optional INTENT(IN) scalar integer dummy. No OUT/INOUT, pointer, allocatable, coarray, assumed-rank, or generic-call condition is violated. PRESENT guards every value access.
Delimiter programs check the justified expression result 20, separate DATA values 11 and 17, and each element of the two fixed-shape constructor results.
fixture_review.diagnostic_basis: R601/R602 retain the numbered-syntax capability basis. Prose lexical classifications have context-dependent diagnostic obligations, and the character effects do not invent mandatory rejection cases. All new executable fixtures are conforming programs.

integration_repair.issue: Default-kind ICHAR unnecessarily assumes that its integer result kind can represent the size of the processor character repertoire. That premise is not guaranteed by the scoped letter requirement.
integration_repair.source_basis: 16.9.105 p5, PDF page 419; direct character equality in 10.1.5.5.1 p7-p8, PDF pages 180-181.
integration_repair.repair: Use direct length-one character equality for the pairwise identity oracle and update its catalogue definition. No code values, case offset, ordering, or repertoire-size integer kind is needed.
integration_repair.classification: Portability repair, not an observed failure on the three installed processors.
integration_repair.evidence_policy: Refresh the affected observation and all fingerprints before approving the integrated batch.

reference_adjudication.source_only_rationale: R1526-R1528 and C1538-C1544 admit the conditional argument with integer expression 37 and .NIL. for the optional INTENT(IN) integer dummy. Under 15.5.2.3 p1-p2, selecting 37 supplies that argument and selecting .NIL. makes it absent. PRESENT has precisely the checked result under 16.9.163 p3-p5, and the absent dummy is never referenced for its value. GNU rejects the syntax; Flang's f2018 mode fails at the F2023 question mark. Neither observation refutes the F2023 source oracle, and neither is counted as reference validation.
reference_adjudication.conditional_expression_limit: The separate question-mark control is corroborated by GNU but not Flang's f2018 fallback. The latter is a recorded mode/support limit, not an invalid F2023 program.

pending_graphics_oracle.rationale: Source acceptance and character equality do not certify displayed graphic forms. A bounded processor source/display-interface review must identify the interface and its documented encoding/rendering, compare all required character groups with the pinned source, and retain the currency-symbol and graphic-style exceptions.
pending_graphics_oracle.next_evidence: Add a separately reviewed processor-interface evidence contract before crediting these facets. Do not invent a runtime glyph query, require a particular font, or relabel these facets as covered by ordinary parsing.
